modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate loaded NVML version and API accessibility with named DCGM subtests and their full results, not merely the suite exit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds library provenance, NVML-specific coverage mapping, secure execution, complete output and restoration.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A driver/NVML mismatch can cause partial discovery, skipped tests or service failure while other diagnostics appear healthy.

review_improvement: Connects the generic level-4 suite to the named NVML dependency and requires evidence that its specific path loaded and ran.
independent_technical_reasoning: NVML is a shared library/API boundary between DCGM and the driver. Device enumeration alone or a suite-level status can hide ABI mismatch and skipped plugins, so acceptance needs the resolved library identity, API access and explicit NVML-relevant subtest results from the same run.
